# PSPSDK NID data

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Upstream | https://github.com/pspdev/pspsdk |
| Commit | `c3da4314d783ac26323e5cdaf8163ac369c2089d` |
| License | BSD-3-Clause (`LICENSE`, copied verbatim) |
| Imported | 2026-10-30 |
| Disposition | generated data only; no upstream source files vendored |

`configs/nids.csv` is generated by `tools/nids/generate.py` from the
`IMPORT_FUNC "Library",0xNID,name` lines in the pinned PSPSDK import stubs.
The generator fetches only the library stubs needed by this profile, plus a
small recorded supplement for NID/name pairs missing from PSPSDK master
(public interface facts, cross-checked against PPSSPP/UOFW NID tables). The
CSV is committed so builds never need network access; `configs/nids.csv.sha256`
pins its content.

Refresh procedure: bump the commit, run

```sh
python3 tools/nids/generate.py --ref <commit> \
    --out configs/nids.csv --pin configs/nids.csv.sha256
python3 -m unittest tests.test_nids -v
```

and update this file. NID values and symbol names are interface facts; no
PSPSDK code is copied into the runtime.
